QuestInfo.name: Welcome to the Neighborhood
QuestInfo.0: You came back after looking around the house. You should talk to #bSilver#k again.
QuestInfo.1: The Pointy-Ear Foxes have a tradition of giving rice cakes to their neighbors whenever they move to a new place. Give the Brown Rice Cakes that you got from Silver to your neighbors.
QuestInfo.2: The Pointy-Ear Foxes have a tradition of giving rice cakes to their neighbors whenever they move to a new place. You gave the Brown Rice Cakes that you got from Silver to your neighbors. They're pitying me for not having fox ears or a tail.
